title: external-check-result/v0
description: What an external rules checker prints on stdout, as one JSON object, when a deal check runs it on an external-check-input/v0 (external-check-input-v0.schema.json): the ruleset it evaluated (an id and the digest of its definition, both the checker's own), one verdict, and a finding for every rule it evaluated, passes included. Exit 0 means a result was printed, whatever its verdict; any other exit is a refusal of the input, named on stderr, and prints no result. A rolling window is evaluated over the history the deal check supplies; a checker given no history, or too little (history_scope.complete false, or fewer days than the window), reports that rule not_evaluable. Members not listed here are refused. An absent tier reads as judged, never recomputed.

ruleset_id.description: The ruleset the checker evaluated, as the checker names it, version included.

definition_digest.description: The SHA-256 of the ruleset's definition, as the checker computes it: lowercase hex. A profile may pin it, and a check whose checker reports another does not count as checked.

verdict.description: allow: nothing in the ruleset stands against the action. deny: the ruleset does not allow it. escalate: the ruleset asks for the person's approval. not_evaluable: the ruleset could not be evaluated on this record.

tier.description: How the verdict was reached, as in Result v0's Tier (agent-action-capsule: spec/evidence-result-v0.md section 1, schemas/evidence-result-v0.json $defs/Tier): recomputed (computed from the record by a procedure anyone can rerun) or judged. Optional. An absent tier reads as judged, never recomputed.

grade.description: The grade of the evidence behind the result, by reference to Result v0's Grade (agent-action-capsule: spec/evidence-result-v0.md section 1, schemas/evidence-result-v0.json $defs/Grade), mirrored, never redefined: self-attested, witnessed or countersigned. Optional; absent states no grade.

findings.description: One entry per rule evaluated, in the ruleset's order, passes included.

id.description: The rule's id within the ruleset.

check.description: The kind of check the rule is, as the checker names it.

reason.description: Why, in words a person reads: shown when the rule fails or cannot be evaluated.

limit.description: The limit the rule applied: a number, or a string of at most 64 characters with no line break. Never counterparty data: a limit and the value from the record the rule compared with it (an amount, a count, a window total), never a name, a contact detail or an identifier. capsulectl refuses to seal one shaped like a phone number or an email address, or holding the digits of the deal's counterparty details, and the check then pauses with the rules not checked.

value.description: The value the rule compared with the limit: a number, or a string of at most 64 characters with no line break. Never counterparty data: a limit and the value from the record the rule compared with it (an amount, a count, a window total), never a name, a contact detail or an identifier. capsulectl refuses to seal one shaped like a phone number or an email address, or holding the digits of the deal's counterparty details, and the check then pauses with the rules not checked.
